headline: Violent Shocks Rake Central Fronts While Northern Turmoil Concentrates
war_summary: The frenzied turnover that gripped Stlican Shelf has abruptly paused over the past two hours, yet the wider northern and central lines remain in a state of violent flux. Weathered Expanse endures as the epicenter of upheaval, registering six fresh strategic transitions and staggering losses exceeding thirty-four hundred men in two hours under rapidly accelerating casualty rates. Westward, Stonecradle remains fiercely contested across The Cord and Trammel Pool, with three recent exchanges leaving one redoubt reduced to no-man's-land amid heavy bloodshed. Farranac Coast mirrors this instability, posting three rapid base changes around Transient Valley alongside two thousand casualties in the latest two-hour window. Further inland, Linn of Mercy has reopened in earnest, yielding three base transitions across Ulster Falls and The Long Whine as fighting intensifies. Viper Pit similarly records ongoing skirmishes at Blackthroat, while Callahan's Passage endures an immense attritional maelstrom—sacrificing over twenty-five hundred men in two hours without shifting a single boundary. With eastern coastal sectors settling into relative lull, tactical violence remains firmly concentrated across these volatile corridors.
